questions.stem: Which of the following numbers is a prime number?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 23. A prime number has only two factors: 1 and itself. Among the options, 23 has only two factors, 1 and 23. The other numbers have more than two factors: 4 (1, 2, 4), 6 (1, 2, 3, 6), and 8 (1, 2, 4, 8).

hi.stem: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी संख्या एक अभाज्य संख्या है?
hi.solution: सही उत्तर 23 है। एक अभाज्य संख्या के केवल दो गुणनखंड होते हैं: 1 और स्वयं। विकल्पों में, 23 के केवल दो गुणनखंड, 1 और 23 हैं। अन्य संख्याओं के दो से अधिक गुणनखंड हैं: 4 (1, 2, 4), 6 (1, 2, 3, 6), और 8 (1, 2, 4, 8)।
hi.critique: The Hindi translation is accurate, maintains the same meaning, and uses standard mathematical terminology.

questions.stem: Which of the following statements is true about co-prime numbers?
choices: If two numbers have no common factors, they are co-prime.
If two numbers have a common factor of 2, they are co-prime.
If two numbers have a common factor of 1, they are not co-prime.
If two numbers have more than one common factor, they are co-prime.
questions.solution: The correct answer is that if two numbers have no common factors, they are co-prime. A co-prime pair of numbers has a greatest common factor of 1, meaning they share no other common factors. The other options are incorrect because a common factor of 2 or more than one common factor would mean the numbers are not co-prime, and having a common factor of 1 is the defining characteristic of co-prime numbers.

questions.stem: What is the smallest number that has three different prime numbers in its prime factorisation?
questions.solution: The correct answer is 30. The prime factorisation of 30 is 2 × 3 × 5, which includes three different prime numbers. The other options do not meet this requirement: 24 is 2 × 2 × 2 × 3, 28 is 2 × 2 × 7, and 36 is 2 × 2 × 3 × 3, each having fewer than three different primes.

questions.stem: If 14560 is divisible by 2, 4, 5, 8, and 10, which two numbers could Guna have checked to conclude this?
questions.solution: If a number is divisible by 8, it is automatically divisible by 2 and 4 as well. If it is divisible by 10, it is also divisible by 2 and 5. So checking for 4 and 5 is sufficient. Checking 2 and 10 is not sufficient because 10 includes 2, but 2 alone does not ensure divisibility by 5 or 4.

questions.stem: In a game, if the jump size is 14, which of the following pairs of numbers will both be landed on?
questions.solution: The jump size 14 will land on 28 and 70. 35 and 50 are not multiples of 14. 42 and 63 are not multiples of 14. 56 and 84 are multiples of 14 but 84 is not in the range of 14's multiples up to 70.
